description: This file defines the LeadController class for managing lead forms in the ERPNext CRM module, including setup, event handling, and related actions.

classes.name: erpnext.LeadController
classes.description: Controller class for lead form interactions, including setup, event handling, and lead-related actions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes form methods and properties, such as required fields.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Sets query filters for form fields when the form loads.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles UI updates and button creation when the form is refreshed.

methods.name: add_lead_to_prospect
methods.description: Associates a lead with a prospect via a prompt and server call.

methods.name: make_customer
methods.description: Creates a customer from the lead.

methods.name: make_opportunity
methods.description: Creates an opportunity from the lead.

methods.name: make_quotation
methods.description: Creates a quotation from the lead.

methods.name: make_prospect
methods.description: Creates a prospect from the lead and pre-fills data.

methods.name: company_name
methods.description: Sets lead name to company name if lead name is empty.

methods.name: contact_date
methods.description: Updates the 'ends_on' date based on contact date.

methods.name: render_contact_day_html
methods.description: Displays contact date information with visual indicators.
